- **D-054 HR time tracking (PLAN 10.3): a TIMESHEET header + TIME-ENTRY lines with project & cost-centre allocation; HEADER-level approval (submit→approve/reject, cancel reopens to draft); a MAINTAINED total_hours; `cost_center_id` VALIDATED against finance, `project_id` OPAQUE/UNVALIDATED until the projects module exists (Phase 11); allocation aggregates over APPROVED entries feed project costing + CO; no cross-module event:** The third HCM plan (s4hana-parity §HCM "Time recording with account assignment (CATS-style timesheet)" = Full), extending the hr module. TWO tables (migration `0039_hr_time`, down_revision 0038, no trigger-bearing alters, reversible, portable both engines, ≤63-char ids, zero autogenerate drift on SQLite + PG, applies on PG to head): `hr_timesheets` (`Timesheet`), `hr_time_entries` (`TimeEntry`). `models/time.py` joins the hr models package; `service/` gains `timesheets.py` (header + entry CRUD), `timesheet_lifecycle.py` (the approval transitions), `time_reads.py` (list + pagination), `time_allocation.py` (the aggregates), and the timesheet schemas live in a sibling `time_schemas.py` — each <400 lines (the cap forced the splits; the leave-module precedent). **(a) THE TIMESHEET + ENTRY MODEL (the clean SAP-like model: a header groups time entries over a period and is approved as a whole; chosen over per-row TimeEntry status).** `Timesheet` is the period HEADER — composite tenant FK to `hr_employees`; claims a gapless **`TS-`** `timesheet_number` AT CREATION (the leave-request claim-at-create precedent, D-040/D-053; `ensure_sequence`+`claim_number`, year_reset) but is NOT a docflow document (no DocumentMixin — a timesheet has no successor document in v1; payroll 10.4 + project costing 11 READ its approved entries via `hr/queries`, not via docflow): `period_start`/`period_end` (Date, CHECK `period_end >= period_start`), `status` (`TimesheetStatus` DRAFT|SUBMITTED|APPROVED|REJECTED), `total_hours` (QuantityType, CHECK ≥0 — the MAINTAINED sum of the entry hours, kept in step by the service on every line add/update/remove, a denormalized running total the stock-balance precedent), `submitted_at`/`approved_at`/`approved_by` (OPAQUE core users id, nullable, no FK — the leave `approved_by` precedent), `notes`. UNIQUE(tenant, employee_id, period_start) — one timesheet per employee per period; UNIQUE(tenant, timesheet_number); index (tenant, employee_id, status). `TimeEntry` is a LINE — composite tenant FK to `hr_timesheets`, NOT separately audited (the header is the audited unit — the journal-line precedent): `entry_date` (Date, validated WITHIN the header period), `hours` (QuantityType, CHECK >0), `task_description`, `is_billable` (bool default false). Entries can repeat per day/project, so there is NO unique constraint on the line — just index (tenant, timesheet_id), plus (tenant, cost_center_id) + (tenant, project_id) for the allocation aggregates. **(b) THE ALLOCATION — `cost_center_id` VALIDATED, `project_id` OPAQUE UNTIL PHASE 11 (the headline decision).** A time entry's `cost_center_id` is an OPAQUE finance cost-centre id (nullable) VALIDATED via `finance/queries.cost_center_exists` when set (D-029, no cross-module FK) — a bad id is a 422 `hr.cost_center_not_found`. A time entry's `project_id` is a NULLABLE OPAQUE `Uuid` STORED AS-IS and NOT validated in v1: the PROJECTS module is **Phase 11 (NOT YET BUILT)**, so there is no table to validate against and **NO forward dependency on projects is created**. The validation hook wires up when `projects/queries` exists in Phase 11 — `add_time_entry`/`update_time_entry` will then call a projects existence probe exactly as they call `cost_center_exists` today, and `hr/queries.approved_hours_for_project` (already shipped) is the per-project hook Phase-11 project costing reads. **(c) THE APPROVAL FLOW (HEADER-level, the leave-request submit→approve/reject precedent, D-053, applied to the SAP CATS model).** Lines are editable ONLY while the header is a DRAFT. DRAFT (create; employee exists, `end >= start`, TS- number claimed) → SUBMITTED (submit; stamps `submitted_at`, lines frozen) → APPROVED/REJECTED (record `approved_by` + `approved_at`). A SUBMITTED timesheet → **cancel = reopen to DRAFT** so the filer can edit and re-submit; APPROVED/REJECTED is terminal (cannot reopen). **APPROVED is the VALUE-BEARING state**: only entries of APPROVED timesheets feed the allocation aggregates. Create/submit/approve/reject are D-013 idempotent. **(d) THE ALLOCATION AGGREGATES (the cost/project allocation deliverable).** `hours_by_cost_center` / `hours_by_project` are SET-BASED GROUP-BY SUMs over APPROVED time entries ONLY (DRAFT/SUBMITTED/REJECTED time is provisional and never costed), each ONE query bounded by an entry-date range (PERFORMANCE §2), the unallocated bucket keyed `None`. They back `GET /timesheets/allocation?by=cost_center|project&from=&to=` and feed project costing (Phase 11) + CO reporting. The `hr/queries` companions `approved_hours_for_project(project_id)` / `approved_hours_for_cost_center(...)` are the per-dimension hooks a later module reads. **(e) Permissions (D-009; the manage vs approve split, the leave precedent).** `hr.timesheet.read` (timesheets + entries + the allocation report); `hr.timesheet.manage` (create / edit draft entries / submit / cancel — the filer); `hr.timesheet.approve` (the DISTINCT approval authority — approve/reject). A `.manage` holder can submit but is 403 on approve. **(f) NO cross-module effect / no events (v1).** Time is intra-HR; payroll (10.4) + project costing (11) READ approved time via `hr/queries`, but time drives no cross-module event in v1, so no `events.py`/`handlers.py` (STRUCTURE §8.3). **(g) Structure.** `timesheet_router.py` mounted into `router.py` (ONE surface at `/api/v1/hr`: timesheets CRUD + submit/approve/reject/cancel; nested `GET/POST /timesheets/{id}/time-entries` + PATCH/DELETE for a line; `/timesheets/allocation` declared BEFORE `/{timesheet_id}` so the literal path wins); paginated lists ≤3-query budget (D-014/PERFORMANCE §6). **Later:** validate `project_id` once projects exists (Phase 11); work-schedule rules + overtime/premium evaluation; per-entry approval; a labour-cost / maintenance-expense journal from approved time. **Phase 10 PLAN 10.3 is COMPLETE.**
